info.name: Nearby Services API
info.description:
All endpoints of the Nearby Services backend, with request/response examples for success and error cases.

**Setup**: import this collection and `nearby-services.local.postman_environment.json`, select the environment and set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` to the seeded admin (`ADMIN_EMAIL` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env`). Run **Auth → Login**: its test script stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken`. **Admin → Create service** stores `serviceId`.

**Errors** always use one envelope:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "not_found",
    "message": "Service ... not found",
    "details": null,
    "request_id": "4f1c2b7e9a0d4c3e8b6a5d2f1e0c9b8a"
  }
}
```
`request_id` matches the `X-Request-ID` response header (sent on every response; you can pass your own).

| Status | code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `invalid_credentials` | Login failed |
| 401 | `invalid_token` | Missing, malformed, expired or wrong-type token |
| 403 | `forbidden` | Admin account inactive |
| 404 | `not_found` | Service does not exist |
| 409 | `conflict` | Same name within 10 m |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | Bulk file > 5 MB or > 10k rows |
| 415 | `unsupported_media_type` | Bulk file not .csv/.json |
| 422 | `validation_error` | Bad body/query/path; `details` lists each field |
| 422 | `invalid_file` | Bulk file unreadable / malformed |
| 429 | `too_many_requests` | Rate limit hit; see `Retry-After` |
| 500 | `internal_error` | Unexpected server error |
| 503 | `service_unavailable` | Login rate limiter (Redis) down |

**Rate limits**: all /api/v1 routes are limited per IP and return `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` (Unix time). `/services/nearby`, admin writes and login have extra limits. /health and /ready are never limited.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Admin authentication. Access tokens go in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

request.description:
Exchange admin email + password for an access token (30 min) and refresh token (7 days). The test script stores both in collection variables.

Rate limited per IP and per email (per minute and per hour). Every attempt counts; a successful login clears the per-email counter. Fails closed: 503 if Redis is down.

Errors: 401 `invalid_credentials` (unknown email, wrong password or inactive admin all give the same message), 422 `validation_error`, 429 `too_many_requests`, 503 `service_unavailable`.

request.description:
Multipart upload of a .csv (columns: name,category,latitude,longitude[,rating,metadata]) or .json (array of objects with the same keys). Extra columns are ignored. Rows are numbered from 1, excluding the CSV header. Rows repeating an earlier row in the file (same name and coordinates) are errors; existing services are not checked for duplicates. A sample file is in `docs/postman/samples/` — set Postman's working directory to `docs/postman` or re-select the file.

Errors: 401, 403, 413 `payload_too_large`, 415 `unsupported_media_type`, 422 `invalid_file` (empty, not UTF-8, malformed, missing columns) or `validation_error` (no file / bad mode), 429.
